_README: Copy this file to config/profile.json and fill in YOUR details. These answers auto-fill LinkedIn Easy Apply forms. config/profile.json is git-ignored so your personal data never gets committed. Nothing is ever submitted without your explicit approval.

work_authorization.note: Set these to match your real situation. Determines how 'authorized to work' / 'sponsorship' questions are answered.

travel.note: Set to false if you cannot travel. When false, triage rejects any role that mentions travel or on-site presence at all — required OR merely 'nice-to-have / valorable' — plus hybrid and periodic office visits. Never claims travel availability on your behalf in a letter or answer.

contract_type.note: Engagement type(s) you want, e.g. 'permanent' (employee / indefinite contract). Triage rejects the types you did not list — freelance / B2B / contractor / temporary. A 'rate per hour / B2B' salary question or a LinkedIn 'Contract' tag is the tell.

salary.note: Set your minimum. If flexible, expectations are answered as 'from <minimum> <currency>, negotiable'.

compliance_defaults._note: Standing answers for legal/compliance attestation questions on application forms. Adjust if any do not apply to you.

years_by_tech._note: Optional. Honest years of experience for SPECIFIC technologies, used to answer 'how many years with <tech>?' screening questions. Keys are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the question. A technology NOT listed here is LEFT BLANK for you to fill rather than guessed, so a tool younger than your career is never overstated. Add your own keys; the ones below are examples.
